blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein is heading ka number “7.2.2.4” chhapa hai. Yeh 7.3.2 (Impacts of the Digital Divide) ka chautha hissa hai, is liye sahi number 7.3.2.4 hai.

Digital divide ki wajah se health (sehat) ki maloomat aur services tak access (pohanch) sab ke liye barabar nahi rehti. Digital platforms health education (sehat ki taleem), telemedicine (internet ya phone ke zariye doctor se mashwara) aur appointment lene ki faidemand sahoolat dete hain. Yeh sahoolat na ho to waqt par maloomat aur ilaj na milne ki wajah se logon ki sehat ke nateeje (health outcomes) kharab ho sakte hain.

Misal: Pakistan mein kam internet wali rural (dehaati) communities ko online reliable (bharose ke qabil) sehat ki maloomat dhoondne ya telemedicine consultation (mashware) mein hissa lene mein mushkil ho sakti hai. Is wajah se un ki bimari ki diagnosis (bimari pehchanna) aur ilaj mein un logon ke muqable mein der ho sakti hai jinhein digital health services ka behtar access hai.

blocks.prompt: Telemedicine kya hai, aur digital divide is ka faida kyun kam kar deta hai?
blocks.explanation: Internet ya phone (video call) ke zariye doctor se mashwara. Is ke liye internet aur device zaroori hain; dehaati ilaqon mein internet kam ho to mareez is se faida nahi utha sakta aur ilaj mein der hoti hai.

items: Sehat ka farq: sehat ki maloomat, telemedicine aur appointments tak kam access; diagnosis aur ilaj mein der.
